claims.sourceText: https://comptroller.war.gov/Portals/45/Documents/afr/fy2018/3-Financial_Section.pdf — DEMOTED from Tier 1 (sourced to an interested party (AARO/DoD) asserting an external fact; primary record of the statement, not of the fact); needs primary replacement
claims.text: Norquist signed the FY2018 DoD Agency Financial Report message as Under Secretary of Defense (Comptroller)/Chief Financial Officer, writing: 'In FY 2018, the Department underwent its first full-scope financial statement audit. As anticipated, our independent auditor, the Department of Defense Office of Inspector General, issued a Disclaimer of Opinion as the result of the audit.'

edges.label: Signed the FY2018 report announcing the first full-scope audit and its disclaimer
edges.note: Norquist, as USD(Comptroller)/CFO, wrote that 'In FY 2018, the Department underwent its first full-scope financial statement audit' and that the OIG 'issued a Disclaimer of Opinion'. Attested by his own signed message in the FY2018 Agency Financial Report.

b.label: Department of Defense Office of Inspector General

edges.label: The OIG is the independent auditor issuing the annual opinion
edges.note: The DoD/DoW Office of Inspector General has issued the opinion on the agency-wide financial statements every year since FY2018, each time a disclaimer. Attested by the FY2018 AFR and by DOWIG-2026-081.

title: DoD Agency Financial Report FY2018, Financial Section
